spanish: Y tu viña no rebusques, y grano caído de tu viña no recojas; al pobre y al peregrino dejarás a ellos; yo Jehová su Dios.

findings.issue: «grano» names cereal grain. H6528 is one construct noun for the vine’s broken-off fallen fruit, so the Spanish names a crop the token does not license.
In current Latin American Spanish «peregrino» primarily means pilgrim and can add a journey the token does not state. H1616 is a masculine singular sojourner or resident alien.
The definite article in «al» is grammatical smoothing. The token is a preposition plus an anarthrous masculine singular adjective.

notes: «su Dios» is the ustedes possessive of the 2mp suffix and is not a third-party shift; the verbless clause has no unmarked copula.
